card.name: The word at before monitoring schedules
card.fires_on: The word "at" right after a monitoring or testing phrase (e.g., renal function, liver enzymes, blood glucose testing), just before "baseline", "the beginning of treatment" or "regular intervals".

modes.label: At start of treatment
modes.description: "at" after a test or assessment, leading into "the beginning of" treatment.
modes.example: Assess renal function<< at>> the beginning of the concomitant treatment

modes.label: At baseline or intervals
modes.description: "at" after a lab or exam, leading into "baseline" or "regular intervals".
modes.example: Evaluate liver enzymes, creatinine, and thyroid function<< at>> baseline and periodically during treatment.

card.plain: It marks the little word "at" that introduces when a lab test or exam should be done, such as at baseline or at the start of treatment.
